title: DeepRepoQA: Code Repository Question Answering with Deep Agent Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2608.24221v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Answering developer questions about a software repository is a critical yet under-explored problem in software engineering. While existing repository understanding methods have advanced the field, they predominantly rely on surface-level code retrieval and lack the ability for deep reasoning over multiple files, complex software architectures, and grounding answers in long-range code dependencies. To address these limitations, we propose DeepRepoQA, a novel question answering (QA) framework for repository-level code understanding. DeepRepoQA builds on an agentic framework where LLM agents find answers through a systematic tree search over the repository structure. A Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) mechanism is employed to empower agents to dynamically search, navigate, and inspect code, enabling effective multi-hop reasoning over long-range code dependencies. translated_title: DeepRepoQA：基于深度代理探索的代码仓库问答
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24221v1 公告类型：新  摘要：回答开发者关于软件仓库的问题，是软件工程中一个关键但尚未充分探索的问题。尽管现有的仓库理解方法推动了该领域的发展，但它们主要依赖于表面级别的代码检索，缺乏对多个文件、复杂软件架构以及基于长距离代码依赖进行答案推理的能力。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了DeepRepoQA，一种针对仓库级代码理解的新型问答（QA）框架。DeepRepoQA基于代理框架构建，其中LLM代理通过系统性的树搜索在仓库结构上寻找答案。采用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）机制，使代理能够动态搜索、导航和检查代码，从而实现对长距离代码依赖的有效多跳推理。在SWE-QA基准上的全面实验表明，其性能显著提升。
tldr: 本文提出了DeepRepoQA，一种利用蒙特卡洛树搜索驱动的代理框架，通过深度多跳推理解决仓库级代码问答中的长距离依赖问题，显著提升了性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DeepRepoQA, an agentic framework driven by Monte-Carlo Tree Search, which addresses long-range code dependencies in repository-level QA through deep multi-hop reasoning, achieving substantial performance gains.
